themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain, France, and Sweden are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize nationals over immigrants in housing, welfare, and public services. This theme reflects a coordinated rhetorical and legislative effort to institutionalize 'national preference' across multiple European countries, often framed as a response to perceived threats from migration and EU mandates.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusia and Balearic housing policies, threatening to block budgets unless PP complies with their demands for preferential treatment of Spanish citizens.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Jordan Bardella proposes cutting France's EU contribution by half and prioritizing French citizens in social housing, framing it as a nationalist economic reform.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Opposes new mosque construction in Malmö and pushes for policies that prioritize Swedish nationals in social housing and welfare access.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox (Castilla y León)
countries.note: New PP-Vox government implements 'priority national' policies in housing and welfare, requiring 12 years of residency for access.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox (Extremadura)
countries.note: Vows to challenge migrant minor allocations and test suspected ages of unaccompanied foreign minors, reinforcing 'national priority' rhetoric.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina’s far-right President Javier Milei faces growing internal divisions and declining public support as his government grapples with corruption scandals, legislative failures, and economic instability. This theme highlights the transnational ripple effects of his struggles, with right-wing parties in the U.S., Spain, Italy, and Poland reacting to his political vulnerabilities.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei’s government is embroiled in a scandal involving Chief of Staff Manuel Adorni’s undeclared wealth, leading to calls for his resignation from allies and opposition alike.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump’s administration and allies monitor Milei’s struggles, with some U.S. conservatives distancing themselves from his economic policies and political controversies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders criticize Milei’s handling of internal conflicts, particularly the Adorni scandal, and question his ability to maintain political stability.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing media and politicians highlight Milei’s declining approval ratings as a cautionary tale for populist leaders, emphasizing the risks of economic austerity and political infighting.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish right-wing media and politicians use Milei’s struggles to critique their own opposition, framing his challenges as a warning against radical economic reforms.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across the U.S., France, Italy, and Poland are reacting to the escalating Middle East conflicts, particularly the U.S.-Iran deal and Israel’s military actions. This theme reflects a shared concern over geopolitical stability, energy security, and the role of Western powers in mediating or exacerbating tensions.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump announces a historic peace deal with Iran, framing it as a diplomatic victory while facing criticism from allies and opponents over its terms and implications.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella criticize the U.S.-Iran deal, warning of its potential to destabilize Europe and calling for greater European independence in defense and foreign policy.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni welcomes the U.S.-Iran deal but emphasizes the need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and ensure freedom of navigation, aligning with U.S. and Japanese allies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish President Karol Nawrocki discusses the U.S.-Iran deal with Trump, emphasizing Poland’s strategic interests in regional stability and U.S. military presence.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Hungary, Italy, the U.K., and Argentina are grappling with internal divisions, leadership challenges, and factional infighting. This theme highlights the fragility of far-right coalitions and the transnational nature of their struggles to maintain unity and ideological coherence.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz faces internal criticism after its election defeat, with former allies questioning Orbán’s leadership and the party’s direction. The Tisza Party emerges as a rival, further fragmenting Hungary’s right-wing political landscape.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Tensions rise between Fratelli d'Italia and Lega over leadership, policy priorities, and Salvini’s push to return to the Interior Ministry. Vannacci’s new far-right party further complicates Meloni’s coalition.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK faces internal turmoil, with defections, leadership disputes, and public disagreements over strategy and messaging. Nigel Farage’s dominance is challenged by rising figures like Zia Yusuf and Richard Tice.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei’s government is deeply divided, with factions led by Karina Milei, Patricia Bullrich, and Victoria Villarruel vying for influence. The Adorni scandal exacerbates tensions and threatens legislative cohesion.

themes.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal dominates global discourse
themes.blurb: The U.S.-Iran peace deal, brokered under Trump’s administration, has become a dominant theme in global right-wing and far-right discourse. This theme reflects a shared focus on the deal’s geopolitical implications, its impact on energy markets, and its reception among allies and adversaries.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump announces the completion of the U.S.-Iran peace deal, framing it as a historic achievement while facing skepticism from allies and opponents over its terms and durability.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni welcomes the deal, emphasizing the need to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and ensure freedom of navigation. She aligns with U.S. and Japanese allies in supporting the agreement.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Polish President Karol Nawrocki discusses the deal with Trump, focusing on its implications for regional stability and Poland’s strategic interests.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella criticize the deal, warning of its potential to destabilize Europe and calling for greater European independence in defense and foreign policy.
